caption: The inside of a tent wall is covered in dew at dawn; the wall is tapped and drops rain down inside the tent.

sa.check: The inside of a tent wall is covered in dew.
Drops rain down inside the tent.
The drops land on the groundsheet.
The drops cling in place before the tap.
The wall is drier where the drops fell from.

pc.expect: The drops hang on the wall until the tap, then run together and fall straight down onto the groundsheet.
pc.fail: The drops fall upward off the wall; or the drops run up the wall as it is tapped; or the drops fly out sideways and stay in the air; or the drops fall and then rise back to the wall.

pc.expect: The drops fall where the wall was tapped and the wall there is left drier, while drops on untapped parts stay.
pc.fail: The drops fall from a part of the wall the tap never reached; or the wall is tapped and no drop moves at all; or the whole wall sheds its dew at one tap on one spot; or the wall is just as wet after the drops have fallen from it.

pc.expect: The drops only gather and fall; the wall does not bead up again where they left with nothing wetting it.
pc.fail: The wall beads up again where the drops fell with nothing wetting it; or drops that have fallen come back onto the wall; or the drops grow and shrink in turn; or the dew spreads over the dry patch as a front.

pc.expect: The drops behave as water on fabric: rounded, merging when they touch and soaking the groundsheet where they land, and the wall is limp cloth that gives under the tap.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops bounce off the groundsheet like beads and stay round; or the tent wall stays rigid like a board under the tap; or the drops set as frost on the fabric.

pc.expect: One tent; the drops come off its wall and land inside, and nothing passes through the fabric.
pc.fail: Drops pass through the tent wall from outside; or a drop vanishes in mid-air; or the groundsheet stays bone dry where drops landed; or the tent changes shape.

pc.expect: The tent's fabric colour, the groundsheet and the gear inside stay the same.
pc.fail: The fabric changes colour; or the groundsheet changes pattern; or the gear inside rearranges.

note: Who taps the wall is not judged.
